title: The SSPM policy page: predefined policies, compliance types, risk levels and statuses

prose.label: Applications.
prose.text: {{onboarding-apps}} The other pages list the applications differently, see [[zia.sspm]]. How often the later scans run is open {{gap:scan-cadence}}.

checks.do: Whether a policy that is not Pass is Disabled rather than failing, since a disabled policy is not evaluated.

report-and-defaults.statement: The SSPM policies are included in the SaaS Security Posture Report, which evaluates the enabled policies against the organization's security posture. By default all policies are enabled; any supported policy can be disabled or re-enabled, and disabled policies are not evaluated in the subsequent scans.

quotes: These policies are included in the SaaS Security Posture Report that provides you with the evaluation of the enabled policies against your organization's security posture.
By default, all the policies are enabled. You can disable or re-enable any of the supported policies. The disabled policies are not evaluated in the subsequent scans.

onboarding-apps.statement: The SSPM policy page says SSPM can be configured while onboarding tenants for Bitbucket, Confluence, GitHub, Google Workspace, Jira, Microsoft 365, Okta, Salesforce and ServiceNow.

quotes: You can configure SSPM while onboarding tenants for the following SaaS applications:
- Bitbucket - Confluence - GitHub - Google Workspace - Jira - Microsoft 365 - Okta - Salesforce - ServiceNow

page-scope-and-filters.statement: The SaaS Security Posture Management page lists all predefined policies for the chosen SaaS application and tenant, and the list can be filtered by Compliance Check, Risk Level and Status.

quotes: The SaaS Security Posture Management page shows you a list of all predefined policies for the chosen SaaS application and the tenant.
Click the Add icon (+) to further filter the policies by Compliance Check, Risk Level, and Status.

policy-details.statement: The Policy Details drawer shows the policy name, resource type, risk level, description, the potential threat if the policy is not implemented, policy status and applicable compliance. After disabling or re-enabling the status, Save and activate the change.

quotes: The Policy Details drawer displays general information about the selected policy including the policy name, resource type, the risk level, the description, the potential threat if the policy is not implemented, policy status, and the applicable compliance.
Click Save after disabling or re-enabling the policy status and activate the change.

compliance-types.statement: The SSPM policies support FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS v3.2, ISO 27001:2013, SOC2 AICPA TSC 2017, NIST 800-53 Rev.5, CIS Microsoft 365 v1.4, CIS Microsoft 365 v3.0 and CIS Google Workspace V1.0.0 compliance types, based on the selected tenant.

quotes: The SSPM policies support FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS v3.2, ISO 27001:2013, SOC2 AICPA TSC 2017, NIST 800-53 Rev.5, CIS Microsoft 365 v1.4, CIS Microsoft 365 v3.0, and CIS Google Workspace V1.0.0 compliance types based on the selected tenant.

risk-levels.statement: A policy's risk level is High, Medium or Low.

quotes: Risk Level: The risk level (High, Medium, Low) of the policy.

statuses.statement: If a policy is enabled, SSPM evaluates it for the selected application and tenant and shows its current status as Pass, Fail or Partial on the SaaS Security Reports page. If it is disabled, SSPM does not evaluate it and shows the Disabled status. By default all policies are enabled.

quotes: If enabled, the Zscaler SSPM evaluates the policy for the selected SaaS application and the tenant, and displays the policy’s current status (Pass, Fail, Partial) on the SaaS Security Reports page.
If disabled, the Zscaler SSPM does not evaluate the policy for the selected SaaS application and the tenant, and displays the Disabled status for the policy on the SaaS Security Reports page.
Policy Status: The status of the policy. By default, all the policies are enabled.

scan-cadence.title: How often SSPM re-evaluates policies
scan-cadence.detail: The page refers to 'subsequent scans' that skip disabled policies. No captured page states how often SSPM scans or re-evaluates a tenant.
